title: Impeccable experience
text:
Our guide Susanna was very knowledgeable, made the tour fun and lighthearted. 

Going to El Alcazar early is a MUST, we were the first ones to see each room. We captured beautiful photos 

It's an expensive tour, but saved us from a last minute cancellation from the awful and unreliable Tickets4U operator!

Many thanks to the team for making our trip a special one.
